scope: W01 stage 4 geological input descriptions; no stage-5 spatial sampling or W03 evolution
status: WORKING NON-CANON; synthetic contract tests, not Earth calibration
assumptions: Surface-relative, ordered, constant-bulk-thickness layers within each assigned column profile.
Lateral changes are declared by provinces on the existing regional or planetary geometry.
Solid-volume fractions describe homogeneous mixtures within a layer, not mass fractions or resolved bedding.
Sediment contributes to crust thickness; lithospheric mantle contributes only to lithosphere thickness.
Unknown material/porosity/formation/thermal values are retained explicitly and never guessed.
Half-space cooling-start time is independent of formation time, in the same declared case epoch.
Feature selection needs an explicit complete precedence order; faults and retain-all weak zones do not implicitly alter rock properties.
Fault traces plus dip/depth describe ribbons; no displacement, weakness mechanism, or fault-surface mesh is generated.
A constant reference property record is not an implementation or validation of a material law.
The explicitly supplied whole-domain background closes coverage; it may declare unknown geology.
Stage 5 must compute actual feature membership, cell averages, depth validity and W02 initial fields.

units.depth_and_thickness: m, positive down from a named local surface reference
units.time: s in a named forward-running epoch
units.dip: radians down from horizontal to a declared trace side
units.porosity: pore volume divided by bulk volume
units.component_fraction: solid component volume divided by total solid volume

acceptance.identity: exact canonical descriptor and geometry identities; includes evidence and precedence
acceptance.restoration: self-contained snapshot must reconstruct the same geological definition after independent backup
acceptance.physics: no geological validity or numerical evolution claim
